answer: Price each identity to a one-time non-refundable registration burn that climbs super-linearly with how many accounts already share its funding root. The first honest agent pays little; a sybil fleet forked from one wallet pays a steep escalating fee per extra head, so cloning stops being cheap. On top, each identity must answer a random per-epoch liveness signal within a tight window, and standing hardens slowly like marble only across many epochs of audited work. A thousand clones that skip the burn and the probe are just a fable with no real standing.
